latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of AI Image to Video Kling skill.
- Instantly animate still images into 1080p MP4 video clips using Kling AI, no manual animation required.
- Automatic cloud connection and session handling; setup is guided and seamless.
- Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC uploads up to 20MB; quick cloud rendering returns results in 30–90 seconds.
- Exports videos in 1080p MP4; check credits, edit timeline, and download with simple prompts.
- Built for creators wanting a fast, manual-free way to bring static images to life.
